item.title: Walk the World by shmu Create Express Transform Group
Youth Media vs Chemistry!
item.description: Dr Alan McCue from the University of Aberdeen visits shmu Our Youth Media Team were recently visited by Dr Alan McCue from the University of Aberdeen in partnership with the Curiosity Fund during British Science Week! The group got to watch multiple chemistry demonstrations, film them and speak about it on their radio show. Check out the video, then read on to find out what some of the group thought of it all... read more

item.title: An exciting digital broadcasting future for the city
item.description: shmu to apply for small-scale DAB licence We are applying for a small-scale Digital Audio Broadcasting (DAB) licence through Ofcom to run an initiative that will provide an exciting opportunity for the future of radio in the city. The new Small Scale DAB platform will carry up to twenty different stations in digital quality and will provide an affordable long-term digital future for many existing broadcasters, as well as offering a platform to support local broadcasters to flourish. read more

item.title: Wellbeing Wednesdays at shmu HQ
item.description: Join us for a cuppa, a chat & a range of wellbeing activities Join us for a cuppa, a chat and a range of wellbeing activities on Wednesdays at shmu Our Wellbeing Hub takes place every Wednesday from 2pm - 4pm at shmu HQ, Station Road, Woodside We also hold a Wellbeing Walk on the last Wednesday of the month from 1pm - 2pm (check our socials for location) read more

item.title: Aberdeen Student Show contributes to shmu
item.description: Record breaking year as show backs 50 local charities We were delighted to be invited to the recent disbursement ceremony for the Aberdeen Student Show! The Student Show raised a phenomenal, record breaking amount of money with their recent show 'Seagully Blonde' - a whopping £167,439.04 for 50 local charities. read more

item.title: CashBack North East 2024-25 Report
item.description: Read the report on our work for the Scottish Government programme The 2024-25 report for our CashBack NorthEast programme has been published. CashBack for Communities is the Scottish Government’s programme which repurposes money seized from proceeds of crime into projects for young people who face disadvantage. read more

item.title: Angela Joss 'Bee You' Memorial Award 2026
item.description: Nominations open now We are delighted to open nominations for the 2026 Angela Joss ‘Bee You’ Memorial Award, created to honour the legacy of a remarkable woman whose kindness, resilience and unwavering commitment to community continues to inspire. Presented annually by shmu, the award recognises individuals across Aberdeen who embody Angela’s values - bringing people together, championing others, overcoming challenges and spreading kindness. read more
